paper.title_en: Emergence of quadrupole and octupole collectivity near <math><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>50</mn></mrow></math> and <math><mrow><mi>Z</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>40</mn></mrow></math> : Coulomb excitation of <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Mo</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mn>92</mn></mmultiscripts></math>
paper.abstract_en: The collective structure of low-lying states in the <math><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>50</mn></mrow></math> nucleus <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Mo</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mn>92</mn></mmultiscripts></math> <math><mo>(</mo><mi>Z</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>42</mn><mo>)</mo></math> has been investigated through sub-barrier Coulomb excitation using the CHICO2 device coupled to the <math><mi>γ</mi></math>-ray energy tracking in-beam nuclear array (GRETINA). Quadrupole and octupole collective properties are measured for the <math><msubsup><mn>2</mn><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo></msubsup></math>, <math><msubsup><mn>2</mn><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo></msubsup></math>, <math><msubsup><mn>2</mn><mn>3</mn><mo>+</mo></msubsup></math>, <math><msubsup><mn>2</mn><mn>4</mn><mo>+</mo></msubsup></math>, and <math><msubsup><mn>3</mn><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo></msubsup></math> states. The spectroscopic quadrupole moment for the <math><msubsup><mn>2</mn><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo></msubsup></math> state is measured to be <math><mrow><msub><mi>Q</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0.23</mn><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mspace width="0.28em"/><mi>e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi></mrow></math>, showing a weakly deformed oblate nature in good agreement with recent state-of-the-art Shell-Model calculations. A modest reduced electric-octupole transition strength of <math><mrow><mi>B</mi><mrow><mo>(</mo><mi>E</mi><mn>3</mn><mo>;</mo><msubsup><mn>3</mn><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo></msubsup><mo>→</mo><msubsup><mn>0</mn><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo></msubsup><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>15</mn><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mspace width="0.28em"/><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">W</mi><mo>.</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">u</mi><mo>.</mo></mrow></mrow></math> is obtained, in disagreement with the literature, revealing an emerging tension in the strength of octupole collectivity for the <math><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>50</mn></mrow></math> nuclei between historic <math><mrow><mo>(</mo><mi>e</mi><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>e</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo>)</mo></mrow></math> and <math><mrow><mo>(</mo><mi>p</mi><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>p</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo>)</mo></mrow></math> experiments and more recent experiments utilizing Coulomb excitation and lifetime plus branching-ratio data.
